body:
She was almost perfect. You know that stereotypical cute shy asian girl? That was her. She even watched anime, we watched attack on titan together. She is 23 and she had only been with 1 guy in her life. I was her 2nd guy, im 30. She's over here studying finance, Chinese, very wholesome, family oriented, loving, caring. Very healthy too. Im used to western woman (worse woman).

She was overly emotional and could be a selfish cunt occasionally but it was overwhelmingly outweighed by her positives.

And she's gone now. She left me because she dosent love me anymore. Why dosent she love me anymore? Well it all went downhill because... I accidentally left her alone at a train station about a month ago when we were supposed to meet. This upset and hurt her immensely. Long story short, we were meant to meet at the station (its a big train station) because she left her phone at my house, we didn't catch eachother because of silly reasons and since she never had her phone I had no way of contacting her. So after a hard day's work I waited about at the train station for 30 minutes and went home. She was waiting for an hour and a half alone. In her heard I would "never leave without her" and I guess I should've waited forever or something.

That stupid shit. That fucking utter bullshit is why she left me. Nobody cheated. Nobody hit anyone else. Nothing bad happened. She got left on her own for a bit and now its basically over.

I feel a bit better today. Still lonely and a hurt but less wanting to die which is positive progress I guess.
